newsitem.title: UK: MEPC expects div cover to improve in 1998.
newsitem.headline: MEPC expects div cover to improve in 1998.

text.p: British property group MEPC Plc said on Tuesday it expected its dividend cover to improve in 1998 and beyond. MEPC also said it would maintain its dividend at 20 pence per share for 1997.

In its interim results statement, MEPC said it had made pre-tax profits of 75.7 million pounds ($123.7 million) for the six months to March 31 before a 73.2 million pound provision for swap terminations announced in April. MEPC will pay a maintained interim dividend of 5.25p per share.
MEPC said a detailed review of its financial position had concluded that both the cost of its debt and the proportion of fixed-rate borrowing were too high.
This had led to the cancellation of a number of sterling interest rate swaps in April and the 73.2 million stg exceptional charge was being made against 1997's profits as a result.
The group said substantial savings in finance costs were already being made and as a consequence of these actions it expected the improved dividend cover in 1998 and beyond.

Based on sterling interest rates at the time of the swap cancellation, the projected increase in pre-tax profits amounted to 9.0 million stg in the second half of 1997 and 19 million stg and 16 million stg in 1998 and 1999 respectively.
"The benefits will continue through to 2010, but at reducing levels," it said.
